cases.study_information: Table6 reports four dual-binding ADT1-4-x/ADT5-1n constructs; the n suffix is retained and is not silently equated with the nonsuffixed TAK-505/ADT1-4-2/ADT5-1 used in the PBMC experiment. Example11 compares4h CD107a degranulation by skin-derived Vδ1 γδT cells with tumor targets at1:1 E:T,37C. Example12 measures24h live-GFP A375 target-cell lysis at1:1 E:T with a top antibody concentration of100nM. The source states similar degranulation across <1–60nM Vδ1 affinities and no significant lysis differences in the tested panel; individual figure-derived potency values are not supplied.
